method.window: Use the driver summary/window verbatim; validate required structure and raw continuity without redefining window selection.
method.qualifications: Observed report/endpoint/hash/input evidence and declared conditions only. No FPS acceptance threshold is invented.
method.requiredCondition: Release; two headed native-GPU desktop processes; CPU rates [4,4]; D0; relay 39 +/- 5 ms without burst/drop; independent Page-clock continuous 120 Hz joystick.
externalBuildChecks: H8 is a compile-time constant, not independently exported by this report.
Release compiler macros and A/B source differences require frozen build identities.
Raw identity is not a before/after filesystem-drift audit.
method.newStateFrequency: 1000 * body new-state gap count / gap total, separately for rAF and Page. logicHz counts prediction-frontier progress.
method.nativeCost: Existing native callback wall time, not CPU self time, whole JavaScript callback duration, or GPU completion.
method.input: Conditional changed-wire-to-new-state proxy only; firstWire is send intent, not delivery or exact capture. No physical touch, Launcher bridge, visible-effect or photon claim.
method.comparison: Run order is preserved without guessing A/B labels. Same source plans do not imply same captured tapes, world trajectories, packet delivery, browser scheduling or host load.
method.teardown: teardownClean is retained separately. False does not automatically become a performance failure or erase qualified workload evidence.
method.failures: All inputs and all discovered disqualification reasons are retained; failed or incomplete runs are never filtered out. Exit 0 means the summary was written, not that runs qualified.

performanceAcceptance: Not automatically assessed; review all runs and long-gap tails.

routeEvidence.scope: Frozen post-workload endpoint. Native capture and asynchronous RTC query are not atomic; request/completion identities and Page clock brackets are retained. No IP/SDP. This is not the current route after trace drain.

peers.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A78B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

worldSaves.scope: endpointDelta shares the summary counter boundaries. bodyCallbackDelta aligns with [start,end) callback costs. These count actual WorldState saves, not input captures.

body.scope: All retained due-event deadlines in the Page body interval. Eventual conditional response may occur after the body. This is not a capture-frame success subset.

rawResponse.method: Conditional render-progress proxy: latest submitted movement event, first subsequent changed native movement wire, then first newly advanced frontier with renderer submission. This does not establish visible movement or per-event gameplay effect.
rawResponse.confounding: Focus can change joystick velocity; death/context changes can write neutral input; clipping, overwritten moves and target convergence can produce no visible movement. First wire observation can follow a capture delayed by backpressure: ordering it after an event does not prove capture followed that event. The submission touch state and changed-controls marker are metadata, not proof of causality. Normalized finger coordinates are not the absolute wire target.
rawResponse.denominator: All configured planned events remain in events + futureEvents. dueEvents and futureCensoredEvents are separate. Coalesced, blocked, clipped, unchanged and unsubmitted events cannot be inferred successful. Hold markers do not manufacture a wire edge.

reportStatus.passScope: Measured workload and frozen endpoint gates; clean post-drain state is reported separately by teardownClean.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

parameters.nativeFrontierObservation: Release pacing ABI sampled on every retained game callback, independently of optional RAF diagnostics

graphicsIdentity.scope: Actual captured core/canvas/existing context after openProbe and before CPU throttling; same-owner read repeated inside the existing failure snapshot. Missing references are unavailable, never inferred from requested browser flags.

renderWork.source: Same onGameFrame th09_game_metrics uint32[10] pointer as samples[11] presentations
renderWork.scope: Optional numeric copies per retained callback, not per simulated frame; uint32 wrap or regression requires separate intervals. No extra draw/tick or per-frame GPU query/readback; these counters are not GPU timings.

touchInput.scope: Synthetic native ABI events on an independent Page clock; not a Launcher/iOS bridge or physical phone test

gpuVsyncControl.scope: Optional single-flag browser diagnostic; addedArgs are launch intent only. Explicit 0/1 requires two verified normal Chrome processes with distinct PIDs and qualified actual argv; unset retains default launch and qualification behavior.

measurementEndpoint.scope: stats/hash/audited/sdl/audio/memory/route aliases are frozen after workload completion, before trace drain. RTC query has separate request/completion clocks and identities. postDrain is a later live observation, not a recertification of the frozen selected route. teardownClean covers that observation before browser disposal, not disposal itself.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control with the optional declared GPU-vsync diagnostic. Proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup and GPU backend selection are unchanged; see gpuVsyncControl for added args and actual argv qualification.

headedControl.scope: Only the two browsers created by this harness. CDP supplies the unique browser PID; CIM reads only that PID. Save only command-line SHA256 and allowlisted flags, never raw command lines, executable/profile paths, or process lists. Missing identity observation is explicit and cannot establish a matched environment control. Window bounds, visibility/focus and existing lifecycle events do not prove physical scanout, continuous foreground visibility, or non-overlap. No window is moved or brought to front.

hostLoad.scope: Whole retained run, not per-gap causal attribution.
hostLoad.source: See unchanged raw hostLoad for retained samples and known-process context.
